plugins.name: abofles
plugins.description: Abo Fles (ابو فليس) counts every token: routes each subagent to the right model and effort, caps agents per task, judges questions before they reach you, and keeps a work memo.

plugins.name: abofles-guide
plugins.description: Abo Fles guide band: the 🧭 next line (what to do now, by priority) above the prompt box. Companion of abofles.
